parole.significato: A small Latin American accordion played with buttons which is frequently used in tango ensembles.
parole.testo: From Spanish bandoneón, from German Bandoneon, named after Heinrich Band.

parole.significato: A non-alcoholic carbonated malt beverage, popular in Latin America.
parole.testo: From Spanish malta, in turn from German Malzbier.

parole.significato: To run away; to leave; to depart.
parole.testo: UK 19th century. Probably from Spanish vamos (“we go”) or vámonos (“let's go”). Possibly influenced by German nehmen (“to take”). Cognate with English vamoose. Possibly backslang from summon.
